Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

imitate verb

also copy, mimic, take after, follow the example of, model oneself on, impersonate

classical

Cic. Rep. 1.36: imitābor ergō Arātum (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Ac. 1.10 (Lewis & Short)
Hor. Ep. 2.2.8: argillā quidvīs imitābitur ūdā (Lewis & Short)

imitor, imitārī, imitātus sum

verb, first conjugation, deponent

imitate, copy; portray

Of an artist, to represent or portray; most often to act like someone, to take as a model (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • imitābor ergō Arātum

    so I shall follow the example of AratusCic. Rep. 1.36 (Lewis & Short)

  • argillā quidvīs imitābitur ūdā

    he will model anything you like in wet clayHor. Ep. 2.2.8 (Lewis & Short)

See also model, example.
